entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Okay, today we're gonna try brewing[n]a cup of coffee from step one.[n]Just listen to what I tell you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: These beans are Colombian, a[n]medium-fine city roast. Oh, and[n]don't let the water boil too much.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...You're gonna be fine.[n]I'll be here the whole time.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Not bad. Though I guess[n]anyone can do something as[n]simple as just brewing it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Making a blend, on the other hand,[n]is a different story. Mixing beans[n]at random won't do you any good.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's because the acidity and the[n]flavor profile all depend on the[n]bean ratio. Pretty deep, huh?
Tell me more.[clr 27]
That sounds tough...
It all tastes the same to me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, somebody's enthusiastic.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you're really that interested,[n]feel free to try out whatever[n]combinations you want to.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Oh, but hands off the[n]expensive beans, got it?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Maybe, but you're just[n]gonna have to take your[n]time and memorize it all.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You can't even tell when one blend[n]is more bitter than another? Eh,[n]you'll get better eventually.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Next up is the curry. There's[n]something special about its flavor.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The truth is, a scientific genius[n]actually came up with the perfect[n]spice combo to complement my coffee.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Something about the quantification[n]of taste... There's no formula for[n]flavor, but it IS pretty damn good.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyhow, we don't make compromises[n]when it comes to food service. Our[n]stuff's gotta wow the customers.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This is a tiny shop, after all.[n]Self-satisfaction is the only[n]thing that keeps me going.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Haven't I already told you I don't[n]have the money? Look at this place.[n]You see many customers in here?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: Oh, no need to hide it, Sakura-san![n]You must have saved plenty from your[n]time working in the government.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: Aren't you taking care of that[n]employee right there too, for[n]nothing more than charity?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: I wish you'd show me the same[n]kindness you show others.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If you're not planning on buying[n]anything, can you please leave?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm expecting a phone call, so I[n]don't have time to chat with you.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: I don't mind if you take the call[n]in front of me. I can talk to your[n]little friend here in the meantime.

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: So, should we keep talking until[n]your call comes in? Or would that[n]be too inconvenient for you?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well...
It looks like Sojiro's in trouble. What should I do...?
Run for help
Call Sojiro's phone[clr 27]
Kick the man out

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What do you think you're doing?[n]Don't get any funny ideas.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, there's that social services[n]call I was waiting for.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: They come 'round pretty often to make[n]sure this guy's not getting in any[n]trouble. Want me to introduce you?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Elderly Man
entries.en: ...Oh, that's right! I have some[n]business I need to take care of[n]myself! I'll come back later!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Does he really have nothing[n]better to do...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* I guess I should explain[n]what's going on. He might try and[n]drop by when I'm not around.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...That man is an old[n]acquaintance of mine who's[n]short on cash right now.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Looks pretty friendly, yeah? Don't[n]let him fool you—it's all an act.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I have to say though... I'm[n]surprised you were quick-witted[n]enough to pull that stuff off.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You really saved me[n]back there. Thanks.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I have to say though, I got pretty[n]lucky there. A lady friend of mine[n]called at just the right time.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...I've gotta thank you too.[n]I could tell you wanted to help.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You were acting way too suspicious,[n]but it was clear you were trying.[n]So, uh... thanks for that.
I feel like my bond with[n]Sojiro is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Still... why do you poke around[n]into other people's troubles?[n]It's way easier to ignore them.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I guess that's just the kinda[n]person you are though, huh...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's that time already?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* I'd report him to the cops[n]if he wasn't related to her...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, uh... never mind that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, that's it for today.[n]Go... study or something[n]after you close up.
